AboutTeaser.label: Our journey
AboutTeaser.heading: Precision is not a style. It's a practice
AboutTeaser.paragraph1: TheCraftMachine started as a two-person studio in a Paris arrondissement with good light and bad Wi-Fi. Seven years later we are still small by design — a tight team of specialists who share an obsession with the details most agencies cut to make margin.
AboutTeaser.paragraph2: We work across web design, brand identity, and film — because these disciplines inform each other. A brand built in isolation from its digital presence is half a brand.

AboutPage.label: Our journey
AboutPage.heading: Seven years building things worth building
AboutPage.intro: TheCraftMachine started as a two-person studio in a Paris arrondissement with good light and bad Wi-Fi. We had one principle: do fewer things, but do them properly. Seven years later, that principle still shapes every decision we make.
AboutPage.story1: We work across web design, brand identity, and film — because these disciplines inform each other. A brand built in isolation from its digital presence is half a brand. A website built without a clear brand foundation is just a collection of pages.
AboutPage.story2: Our team is deliberately small. We are not a full-service agency with departments and account managers. We are a studio of specialists — each one the best we could find — who work closely together on every project. When you work with us, you work with the people doing the work.
AboutPage.story3: We choose our clients as carefully as they choose us. We are not a good fit for every project — and we will tell you that upfront. When we do take a project on, it is because we believe we can do something exceptional with it.
AboutPage.story4: Most of our new work comes through existing clients and referrals. That is not something we engineer — it is the natural result of the work we do and how we do it.

values.title: Craft over output
values.body: We do fewer projects than most agencies. Intentionally. Every project gets our full attention — not a fraction of it.

values.title: Discipline first
values.body: We ask hard questions before we open design software. The strategy informs the aesthetic, not the other way around.

values.title: Long-term clients
values.body: We are not a transactional studio. Most of our clients have been with us for years — they trust us with the decisions that matter.

values.title: Transparent process
values.body: No black boxes. Clients are involved at every stage, every decision is explained, and nothing ships without shared understanding.

maison-verdier.summary: E-commerce experience for a Parisian fine-jewellery atelier.
maison-verdier.description: A considered digital presence for a jewellery house that has been crafting in Paris for three generations. We rebuilt their e-commerce from the ground up — focusing on the slow reveal of each piece, editorial storytelling, and a checkout experience that matches the weight of the purchase.

atelier-brun.summary: Brand identity for an independent Parisian architecture studio.
atelier-brun.description: Atelier Brun needed an identity as precise as their drawings. We built a mark, a typeface pairing, and a visual language that reads with the same rigour as the buildings they design.

collectif-nord.summary: Campaign films for a northern French cultural foundation.
collectif-nord.description: Three short films documenting the communities behind three of the foundation's flagship programmes. Shot on location across Lille, Roubaix, and Tourcoing — warm, unfussy, honest.

studio-leo.summary: Portfolio site for a multidisciplinary creative studio.
studio-leo.description: Studio Léo's work spans furniture, lighting, and installation. Their site needed to hold all three without hierarchy — a grid that breathes.

brasserie-cent.summary: Full brand identity for a craft brewery in Bordeaux.
brasserie-cent.description: From name through label design to tap handle — a complete brand for a new brewery that wanted to feel like it had been there for thirty years.

fondation-maret.summary: Digital archive and public-facing site for an art foundation.
fondation-maret.description: The foundation holds over 4,000 works and needed a site that could serve both researchers and first-time visitors. We built a dual-mode interface — deep search for scholars, curated paths for everyone else.
